title: Shiftform: endless browser platformer
author: luke__uk
selftext:
Hi guys!

I'd like to share a little game I've been working on. It's called Shiftform, an endless platformer where you climb through procedurally generated worlds with constantly changing physics and rules.

One thing I've been particularly focused on is making the actual movement fun and satisfying. A big part of the development process has been automated testing, letting Fable plan movements ahead of time, simulate different inputs and analyse the resulting trajectories.

The game is free and runs straight in web browser: [https://shiftform.app/](https://shiftform.app/)

Would love to hear what you think, especially how the movement feels!
